info.title: india-subscriptions HTTP API
info.description: One API over subscriptions on Indian payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU). Amounts are integer paise and instants are ISO-8601 strings.

post.description: Verifies what the gateway returned to the customer's browser after authorisation, and starts the billing schedule for merchant-scheduled subscriptions. Pass the gateway's result untouched as `result`, and the subscription id your server stored as `expectedSubscriptionId`: a genuine result that belongs to a different subscription is then rejected like a forged one. Calls the gateway.

Currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Only INR is supported.

SubscriptionStatus.description: Normalised subscription lifecycle. Each gateway's own status is preserved verbatim in `providerStatus`. `cancelled`, `completed`, `expired` and `failed` are terminal.

ChargeStatus.description: Normalised status of a charge (one debit).

ChargeKind.description: `authorization` is the small verification debit taken when the mandate is set up, `recurring` is a debit for a billing cycle, `upfront` is a one-off amount such as a setup fee or add-on.

PaymentMethod.description: `upi` is a UPI Autopay mandate, `card` a card standing instruction, `enach` an eNACH e-mandate on a bank account, `physical_nach` a paper NACH mandate.

SchedulingMode.description: Who decides when each recurring debit happens: `gateway` raises every charge on the plan's schedule, `merchant` means the merchant (this library's scheduler) raises each charge.

EventType.description: Normalised webhook / lifecycle event. `unknown` is a verified event this library does not normalise; inspect `raw`.

Environment.description: `test` is the gateway sandbox, `live` is real money.

CancelMode.description: `immediately` stops now with no further charges; `at_period_end` keeps the current paid period, then stops.

ChangeTiming.description: When a subscription change takes effect: `immediately`, or `at_period_end` (the next cycle boundary).

CheckoutKind.description: How the customer's browser or app completes mandate authorisation; the `kind` of a `CheckoutInstruction`.

count.description: Bill every `count` units: `{ unit: 'month', count: 3 }` is quarterly.

id.description: The gateway's customer id, where one exists.

phone.description: Mobile number; 10 digits or E.164. Adapters format it for their gateway.

Customer.description: A customer: identity and contact details.

id.description: Your own plan id. Used where the gateway lets the merchant choose the id; ignored where the gateway generates one.

amount.description: Amount charged every cycle, in paise.

currency.description: Currency of the plan. Defaults to INR.

scheduling.description: Who raises each charge. Defaults to the gateway's native mode.

maxAmount.description: Ceiling the mandate allows per debit, in paise. Defaults to `amount`. Set it higher to leave room for upgrades or add-ons.

maxCycles.description: Number of cycles after which the plan ends. Omit for open-ended.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value pairs stored with the plan.

CreatePlanInput.description: Details of a billing plan to create.

url.description: The page to send the customer to.

FormPostCheckout.description: Authorise by auto-submitting an HTML form to the gateway.

keyId.description: The Razorpay key id to open Checkout with.

subscriptionId.description: The Razorpay subscription id to authorise.

hostedUrl.description: Razorpay-hosted authorisation page, usable instead of the JS checkout.

callbackUrl.description: Where Razorpay Checkout redirects after authorisation (its `callback_url` option).

prefill.description: Customer details to prefill in the checkout form.

sessionId.description: The subscription session id to pass to Cashfree.js.

environment.description: Which Cashfree environment to initialise Cashfree.js with.

CheckoutInstruction.description: What the customer's browser or app must do to authorise the mandate; branch on `kind`.

days.description: Trial length in days from now.

endsAt.description: Or an exact instant at which the trial ends.

Trial.description: Free trial: the mandate is set up now, the first charge happens when the trial ends. Pass exactly one of `days` or `endsAt`.

reference.description: Your own id for this subscription. Sent to the gateway where it accepts a merchant reference, and echoed back on `Subscription.reference`.

plan.description: An existing plan id, or plan details to create inline.

quantity.description: Units of the plan billed each cycle. Defaults to 1.

totalCycles.description: Total number of recurring charges. Omit to bill until cancelled, where the gateway allows.

startAt.description: Delay the first recurring charge to this instant without calling it a trial.

upfrontAmount.description: One-off amount collected together with the authorisation (setup fee or first payment), in paise.

upfrontLabel.description: Label shown to the customer for the upfront amount.

paymentMethods.description: Restrict the mandate to these payment methods. Omit to allow all the gateway supports.

authorizeBy.description: Deadline for the customer to authorise the mandate.

mandateEndsAt.description: When the mandate itself should lapse.

returnUrl.description: Where the gateway sends the customer after authorisation.

notifyCustomer.description: Let the gateway send its own SMS/email to the customer.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value pairs stored with the subscription.

idempotencyKey.description: Makes the create call safe to retry, where the gateway supports idempotency keys.

planId.description: Move to another plan (upgrade or downgrade).

quantity.description: New number of units billed each cycle.

scheduledAt.description: When to debit. Omit for the earliest the gateway allows.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number shown to the customer where the gateway supports it.

notificationId.description: Your unique id for this notification.

amount.description: Amount that will be debited, in paise.

debitAt.description: The date the debit will be attempted.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number to show the customer.

NotifyChargeInput.description: The advance notice RBI rules require before debiting a mandate.

provider.description: The gateway that holds the notification.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription that will be debited.

accepted.description: True when the gateway accepted the notification for delivery.

amount.description: Amount that will be debited, in paise.

debitAt.description: The date the debit will be attempted.

invoiceNumber.description: Carry this into the matching charge call where the gateway requires it.

raw.description: The gateway's response, untouched. Absent when the gateway returned no body.

ChargeNotification.description: The result of sending a pre-debit notification.

ListChargesOptions.description: Options for listing the charges of a subscription.

subscriptionId.description: Required by gateways that scope payments under a subscription.

refundId.description: Your unique id for this refund.

amount.description: Amount to refund in paise. Omit to refund the full charge.

provider.description: The gateway that holds the refund.

reference.description: Your own refund id, where one was supplied.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription the charge belongs to.

CheckoutResult.description: The data the gateway hands back to the browser or return URL after the customer authorises: Razorpay's checkout handler response, the parameters PayU posts to `surl`/`furl`, or the Cashfree return URL query. Pass it on untouched.

result.description: The fields the gateway handed back to the browser or return URL, untouched.

expectedSubscriptionId.description: The subscription id (or your reference) that your server stored when it created the subscription. When given, a result that verifies but belongs to a different subscription is rejected, so a customer cannot replay the authorisation of one subscription to unlock another.

VerifyCheckoutInput.description: What the HTTP service and the facade accept when verifying a checkout result.

provider.description: The gateway that issued the result.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription id to store and use for later calls.

reference.description: Your own reference for the subscription, where known.

authorized.description: True when the customer's authorisation succeeded.

status.description: The subscription status the result implies, where known.

charge.description: The authorisation or upfront charge, where the result carries one.

raw.description: The verified gateway data, untouched. Absent when there is none.

CheckoutVerification.description: The outcome of verifying a checkout result.

rawBody.description: The exact bytes of the request body as a string. Do not re-serialise parsed JSON.

headers.description: The request headers, with lower-case names.

WebhookRequest.description: A webhook request as received from a gateway.

id.description: Stable id for de-duplication: gateways deliver the same event more than once.

provider.description: The gateway that sent the event.

providerEventType.description: The gateway's own event name, verbatim.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened, where the gateway says.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription the event is about.

subscription.description: The subscription, where the event carries it.

charge.description: The charge, where the event carries it.

refund.description: The refund, where the event carries it.

raw.description: The gateway's webhook payload, untouched. Absent when there is none.

scheduling.description: Scheduling modes available; the first is the default.

gatewayPlans.description: The gateway stores plan objects (otherwise plans exist only in your code).

upfrontAmount.description: An upfront amount can be collected with the authorisation.

quantity.description: A subscription can bill several units of a plan.

resume.description: A paused subscription can be resumed.

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: A subscription can be cancelled at the end of the paid period.

changePlan.description: A subscription can move to another plan.

merchantCharges.description: The merchant can raise debits itself (`createCharge`).

merchantPreDebitNotification.description: The merchant must send the pre-debit notification itself (`notifyCharge`).

merchantChargeLeadHours.description: Hours before the debit date by which a merchant-raised charge must be created (with `scheduledAt` set), for gateways that send the pre-debit notification themselves once the charge exists. Absent or 0 means a charge can be raised on the due date itself.

merchantChargeMaxAheadHours.description: Furthest ahead, in hours, that a merchant-raised charge may be scheduled.

listCharges.description: The charges of a subscription can be listed.

signedWebhooks.description: Webhooks carry a signature this library verifies.

idempotencyKeys.description: Create calls accept an idempotency key.

paymentMethods.description: The payment methods mandates can be authorised with.

Capabilities.description: What a gateway adapter can do, so callers never have to guess.

ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error response.

code.description: What went wrong. Branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Do not branch on it.

provider.description: The gateway involved, where one was.

httpStatus.description: The gateway's HTTP status, when it answered. This is not the status of this response.

providerCode.description: The gateway's own error code, verbatim.

retryable.description: True when repeating the same call later is safe and may succeed.

ErrorDetail.description: The error: a stable code, a message and, for gateway failures, what the gateway said.

ErrorCode.description: A stable error code: one of the library's `ErrorCode`s or one of the service's own (`UNAUTHORIZED`, `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`). Branch on this, never on the message.

providers.description: The gateways this service is configured with.

received.description: Number of events the gateway's webhook carried.

WebhookReceipt.description: Acknowledgement of a webhook the service verified.

WebhookPayload.description: The gateway's webhook body, exactly as the gateway sent it.

limit.description: Most schedules to process in this run.

TickRequest.description: Options for one run of the billing scheduler.

openapi.description: The OpenAPI version of the document.

OpenApiDocument.description: This API as an OpenAPI 3.1 document.

TickError.description: A failure of one schedule during a tick.

due.description: Schedules the store reported as due.

locked.description: Due schedules skipped because another worker held their lock.

notified.description: Pre-debit notifications accepted by the gateway.

awaiting.description: Cycles left waiting for the gateway's final answer.

halted.description: Schedules halted because a cycle exhausted its attempts.

expired.description: Pending-authorisation schedules cancelled by their timeout.

errors.description: Schedules that failed during this tick; the others are unaffected.

TickResult.description: What one run of the billing scheduler did. A failing schedule shows up in `errors`; the others are unaffected.

LibraryErrorCode.description: Stable error code of this library. Branch on it, never on the message.
